title: South Carolina AI Laws

reading.body:
South Carolina's only enacted AI law is a ceremonial resolution declaring March 30 through April 2, 2026, AI Week and encouraging residents to learn about artificial intelligence.

The law, H5085, passed February 4, 2026, imposes no requirements on any person or company. It creates no registry, no risk assessment, no disclosure, and no enforcement mechanism. Its only operative effect is a designated week and a general encouragement.

For AI development and deployment, this means South Carolina currently adds no AI-specific compliance burden. The law does not address compute, buildings, or power. The record does not show whether other AI-related bills were introduced or failed.
